content: A 3x2 spatial selection of identical GFTT candidates improved eight known-warp checks from 4/8 to 6/8 but worsened extreme mapping error and two archived motion-consistency comparisons. Do not promote from average pass rate alone.
applicability: Current wrist fixture ROI, 30 tracks, unchanged detector/LK/RANSAC
count_semantics: Eight software image-warp checks, not robot tasks
limitations: Same source image; actual metric accuracy unknown
